title: Voluntary discomfort
idea: Seneca advised setting aside days to live on coarse food and plain clothes, so that hardship loses its power to scare you.
apply: Pick one small, safe discomfort this week, like a cold shower or a skipped meal, and notice that you handle it fine.
remind: Practice a little hardship. Fear shrinks.

scenes.nar: Ben avoids anything uncomfortable. Cold rooms, a skipped meal, and above all hard conversations.

msgs.x: The avoided thing grows bigger each week.

scenes.nar: He tells himself he cannot handle it. And the more he avoids, the bigger each of those things seems to grow.

items.x: Monday: two minutes of cold water

scenes.nar: So he borrows Seneca's practice. He starts with small, safe hardships on purpose. Cold water, a skipped lunch, and then one honest conversation.

items.x: Cold water no longer scares him

scenes.nar: A month later, he knows he can handle more than he thought. The fear shrank because he proved it wrong.
